info.name: Art By Radhika - Backend APIs (with Cloudinary & 200MB Uploads)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman API collection for Art By Radhika Backend. Includes Authentication, Profile Completion, Address Management, Cloudinary File & Image Uploads (up to 200MB), Products with Images & Redis Caching, Complete Mehndi Booking Lifecycle with Reference Photos, and Redis/BullMQ Utilities.

item.name: 0. Admin Dashboard & Analytics (Stats & Charts)
item.description: Comprehensive APIs for Admin Dashboard: Live overall counts, metrics, growth rates, and ready-to-plot chart datasets (Revenue trends, Donut status distributions, Category popularity, User growth, Weekday patterns).

item.name: 0.1 Dashboard Stats & Counts (All Metric Cards & Recent Activities)

request.description: Fetches all live counts: Total Bookings, Revenue, Clients, Designs, Reels, Inquiries, growth percentages, recent bookings, recent inquiries, and top designs.

item.name: 0.2 Dashboard Chart & Graph Analytics (Revenue Trends, Donut, Bar, Growth)

request.description: Returns ready-to-plot chart arrays: monthly revenue trends, booking status distribution (pie/donut), category performance (bar/radar), user growth trends, and weekday booking patterns.

item.name: 0.3 Complete Dashboard Overview (Stats + Charts combined in 1 call)

request.description: Single-call fast endpoint that returns both stats and charts in a single HTTP roundtrip.
